scope.scope: Existing validation/prior-use evidence, BOI-only scientific scope, with fluorescence and excluded IOSI identified separately from existing metadata.
scope.inputs: Current cohort and resolution ledgers, HP/external inventory, repository reference reports, saved local provenance, earlier event-first/runtime/statistics records.
scope.method: Inventory bounded text/provenance corpus; use exact asset/session/animal tokens as search leads only; adjudicate actual use from execution reports and structured receipts. Propagate confirmed development use at animal level. Keep metadata/source inspection separate. Never infer untouched status from absence.
scope.budget: One evidence audit. No image/trace payload reads, downloads, detector, statistics, candidate-method or biological-model runs.
acceptance: 87 unique archive assets and 63 canonical animal labels retained
HP CSV rows and located external leads remain distinct from verified archive identities
every positive use assignment links to evidence
no final eligibility, evaluation role or untouched assignment
current source/analysis rules and prior artifacts preserved
scope.limitations: This workspace cannot establish the complete history of researcher use outside the searched records or unavailable/deleted workspaces. Historical evaluation wording is retained with its method-specific scope.
scope.stopping_decision: Close the evidence audit, restrict claims of independence, and list named validation gaps. No automatic replacement-method experiment follows.

evaluation_decision: No untouched/evaluation role assigned. Recorded analytical use propagates to the animal. Source-only inspection is distinguished and must be disclosed in any later independence decision. Absence in this corpus is not proof of nonuse.

historical_label_resolution.original_scope: ID13/FB2316 were additional backgrounds for the onset fits and already previous pipeline references.
historical_label_resolution.current_role: Both are already-used animals; new waveform shapes or an additional method-specific panel do not supply new independent animals.

unresolved_history: Original study analysis and user V2/AQuA2 experimentation are not fully captured by these workspace execution records.
Deleted/unavailable temporary outputs, other computers/checkouts and unrecorded human inspection are not audited.
Source-only/header inspection is documented but does not by itself determine whether a later biological evaluation is independent.
HP identity conflicts and byte-identical candidates prohibit counting CSV labels as independent animals.
corrections_preserved: Initial summary enumerated empty keys created during lookup, overstating the session list while animal and per-asset assignments were correct. Changed lookups to non-mutating get and required nonempty evidence. Initial script/audit/search inventory retained; final verifier enforces eight documented archive sessions.
